name: Monastery of Alcobaça
description: Founded in 1153 by Portugal's first king, Afonso Henriques, the Alcobaça Monastery stands in the town of Alcobaça, about 120 km north of Lisbon. It was the country's first Gothic building, and its plain, soaring Cistercian church shows the style at its purest. By 1300 it was Portugal's richest monastery, home to almost 1,000 monks.
